title: the Ninth Floor Rising
author: Jonah Kavanagh
blurb: Oscar Coldharbour, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
